title: Experiment Runner Config v0.1
description: Declarative contract for a governed experiment config. The runtime validates the same fields with a stdlib-only check in src/topper_perception/experiments/contracts.py (no jsonschema dependency).

exp_id.description: Immutable experiment identifier; also the per-EXP-ID artifact directory name.

task_id.description: Development task that produced this experiment.

scope.description: smoke is cheap and deterministic; mini/full require a clean Git worktree before QUEUED.

runner_type.description: Registered runner function. 'dummy' is the deterministic no-data runner; 'popu_neural' lazily imports torch and runs the P5.2-A2 neural training smoke.

seed.description: Random seed; same config + seed must reproduce identical metrics.

output_root.description: Base directory under which outputs/experiments/<EXP-ID>/ is created.
